one_liner: All-in-one workspace for notes, tasks, wikis, and databases with a robust REST API.
auth_notes: Requests use the HTTP Authorization header with bearer tokens, and integration supports OAuth2 workflows.
verdict_reason: Notion provides a well-documented public REST API with self-serve token generation and OAuth2 support, making it ready for integration.

extras.rate_limit_note: Standard rate limiting applies per integration token.

evidence.quote: Requests use the HTTP Authorization header to both authenticate and authorize operations. The Notion API accepts bearer tokens in this header.
1. Open Personal access tokens in the Developer portal. ; 2. Select New token. ; 3. Enter a name, select the Notion API capability, and then select Create token.
